title: Only 3% extra iPhones bought, however revenue soared
text:
Home / Business / Only 3% extra iPhones bought, however revenue soared Only 3% extra iPhones bought, however revenue soared 1 min ago Business The iPhone X hasn’t led to a growth within the variety of telephones Apple is promoting, but it surely has saved the corporate’s money-making machine going at full tilt. Apple ( AAPL ) mentioned Tuesday that it bought 52.2 million iPhones in the course of the first three months of the 12 months, up simply 3% from the identical interval a 12 months earlier. Analysts had anticipated Apple to promote 53 million iPhones. Despite the restricted progress within the variety of iPhones bought, Apple gross sales hit $61 billion for the quarter, a rise of 16% from the identical interval a 12 months earlier, fueled by the upper price ticket of the iPhone. The firm’s revenue soared 25% for the quarter, hitting $13.eight billion.
On a convention name with analysts, Apple CEO Tim Cook mentioned the iPhone X was the corporate’s prime promoting mannequin every week within the quarter.
“It’s a type of issues the place a group wins the Super Bowl. Maybe you need them to win by a couple of extra factors, but it surely’s a Super Bowl winner. That’s how we really feel about it,” Cook mentioned. “I couldn’t be prouder of the product.”
The firm cushioned the information with a giant giveaway to buyers.
Apple plans a brand new $100 billion share buyback program and a 16% improve in its quarterly dividends, following on the heels of the US tax regulation adjustments signed late final 12 months.
The tax invoice makes it cheaper for Apple to convey again the greater than $250 billion it holds abroad.
Apple ( AAPL ) inventory rose 3% in after hours buying and selling Tuesday following the earnings report.
Related: Apple sinks on fears of slowing iPhone gross sales
Apple inventory fell this month after considered one of its key chip suppliers warned of “continued weak demand.” Since then, a collection of analysts have slashed their estimates for iPhone shipments.
Daniel Ives, an analyst with GBH Insights, wrote in an investor observe final week that Wall Street was in “full panic mode” over iPhone gross sales forward of Apple’s earnings report.
Much of the priority was directed on the iPhone X. The new mannequin, with a full bleed display screen and facial recognition, was as soon as seen by buyers as key to driving clients to improve their smartphones. But there have been fears that, at $999, it was priced too excessive.
Cook pushed in opposition to considerations that the worldwide smartphone market is saturated, declaring that “a half a billion” telephones that do not provide smartphone options are nonetheless being bought worldwide.
“We nonetheless imagine that over time, each telephone bought will probably be a smartphone,” Cook mentioned. “So it appears to us with that many function telephones being bought, that is a reasonably large alternative.”
